sloka: लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा दारुणं जनकात्मजा ।परं विषादमागम्य वैदेही निपपात ह ।। ७.४८.१ ॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā dāruṇaṁ janakātmajā ।paraṁ viṣādamāgamya vaidehī nipapāta ha ।। 7.48.1 ॥

translations.english: Having heard Lakshmana's harsh words, Sita, the daughter of Janaka, was overcome with extreme sorrow and fell to the ground.
